---
title: "Mediated Agency Attribution Workbench"
---

MAAW is a traceable research environment for comparing claims about human,
psychological, collective, institutional, symbolic, technical, emergent, and
nonhuman spiritual agency.

The workbench does not decide that a spiritual agent caused an event. It records
observations, constructs rival hypotheses, exposes assumptions and evidence
burdens, and prepares findings for human adjudication.
